degree_context.academic_unit: Business, Computer Science & IT Career Pathway
degree_context.general_education_authority: Tidewater Community College General Education Core and Approved Transfer Electives

residency.rule: At least 25 percent of degree credit hours must be earned in coursework at TCC.

modeling_notes: The catalog's 60-63 range controls over the marketing page's single 61-credit figure because mathematics and elective choices vary in credit value.
Preserve the precalculus preparation as MTH 167 OR the MTH 161+MTH 162 bundle OR direct placement into MTH 263 with replacement elective credit.
The two humanities courses must come from two distinct categories among Artistic Expression, Literature and Creative Writing, and Human Culture.
Semester-four technical slots A and B are separate requirement receivers even though their option menus overlap; one course cannot satisfy both.
The approved-transfer-electives page is a required option dictionary, not a source of additional universal course requirements.

data_quality_flags.message: Footnote 8 does not cleanly delimit the additional-science/PHY 201 wording and requires a human source read.
Footnotes 7 and 8 repeat CSC 205/CSC 215 choices across two separate semester-four slots; a flat set loses the requirement count.
The marketing page's View Curriculum link points to archived catoid 21/poid 4756 and redirects to the current catalog home rather than the program.
